name: routing_switch_route_and_params
description: Drives examples/c/routing-components.c, the doc-drift guard for doc/guide/en/architecture/routing.md and components.md. Asserts the home route renders, clicks the button whose callback calls set_route_param + switch_route("/user/:id", id=42), and asserts the user route rendered - which only happens if the pattern matched and the callback's own assertions on get_route_pattern / get_route_param passed.
